def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]; bg=grid[0][0]
    div=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    if not div or not pts: return out
    horizontal=len({r for r,c in div})==1
    if horizontal:
        line=div[0][0]; lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts)
        delta=(line+1-lo) if lo>line else (line-1-hi)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts: out[r+delta][c]=grid[r][c]
        edge=(hi+delta+1) if lo>line else (lo+delta-1)
        if 0<=edge<h: out[edge]=[8]*w
    else:
        line=div[0][1]; lo=min(c for r,c in pts); hi=max(c for r,c in pts)
        delta=(line+1-lo) if lo>line else (line-1-hi)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c+delta]=grid[r][c]
        edge=(hi+delta+1) if lo>line else (lo+delta-1)
        if 0<=edge<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][edge]=8
    return out
